name: DokuWiki
description: Simple, versatile wiki that needs no database. Great for docs, notes, knowledge bases.
compose:
services:
  dokuwiki:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/dokuwiki:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
